editorial.description_en: Flat winter overcast — a cool mid-light grey with no break in it.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の曇り空のような、明るい青灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.800, C 0.015, h 258.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 冬 (fuyu, winter) + 雲 (kumo, cloud), rendaku to -gumo. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Winter Cloud" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 冬雲. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kumori-garasu at ΔE00 5.2, ame-ishi at ΔE00 5.2, asa-moya at ΔE00 7.4. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.015 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
